docs.load: A picture or a 3D model from your files
docs.save: Keeps a result as a file you can download: .png or .jpg for a picture, .gif or .mov for a clip, .glb for a 3D model
docs.blend: The second clip over the first, frame by frame
docs.inpaint: Redraws the masked part of a picture (needs an inpainting model)
docs.t2v: An AnimateDiff clip from a prompt
docs.zoom: An endless zoom, redrawing each frame
docs.outpaint: Zooms out by painting the border of each keyframe
docs.canny: An edge map, for a Canny ControlNet
docs.parallax: A moving-camera clip from one picture and its depth
docs.onnx: An image model exported to ONNX: background removal, depth, upscaling, restoration, style
docs.interpolate: RIFE in-between frames (each pass doubles the frame rate)
docs.depth_mesh: A 3D relief of a picture, raised by its depth and textured with it
docs.render: Pictures of a 3D model: a still, or a turntable clip
docs.image_to_3d: A whole 3D model from one picture (TRELLIS.2 on a GPU); a transparent background marks the object
docs.rig: A skeleton and skin weights for a 3D model, ready to pose and animate (SkinTokens on a GPU)
docs.stereo: Stereoscopic 3D from pictures or video: left and right eye views for 3D TVs, VR players and red-cyan glasses
docs.animate: Moves a rigged figure with motion capture (walk, run, dance...): limbs found on both skeletons, the hips carried along
docs.scribble: A drawing as the scribble ControlNet's input: its strokes white on black, thickened

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.intro: For scripts and apps: a token acts as you within its scopes (it can never change your account, billing or tokens). Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.secretOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only once.

account.supportOn: Support access until {{until}}: you can see this account's pictures and texts; every view is logged.
account.supportOff: No support access: you see this account's jobs without pictures or texts. The account can grant it in its settings (API page).

overview.noProvider: No GPU provider is set up (CAPACITY_PROVIDER).
overview.noPods: No GPU rented now (at most {{max}}). One is rented when an app opens a session.
overview.spendNote: What rented GPUs cost, running ones up to now. At a limit no new GPU is rented.
overview.seeAll: Closed beta: you see every account's pictures and texts without support access (OPERATOR_SEES_ALL_CONTENT). Every look is still logged. Turn it off after the first tests.

jobs.hidden: Pictures and texts hidden: this account has not granted support access.

audit.usageIntro: The usage log as CSV files (jobs, GPUs, sessions, events), for the cost comparison. No personal data.
audit.title: Operator log
audit.intro: Every operator action and every look at an account's content.

support.title: Support access
support.intro: Let NeuraCraft's operators see your jobs' pictures and texts for a while, to help with a problem or during a beta. Every look is logged; it ends by itself.
